The logo: J5 with World of moved to the right

Holger, 27 Sep: J5 is the best; move World of to the right a bit; and is that a bolder font on World of? It is: GLCA SemiBold, 1a’s small line, over Card Games in GLCA Medium. So: World of’s start moved right in three steps, to the card’s lean and one and two steps past it, and a fourth row with World of in Medium for the comparison. J5 is kept as it was. The keepers stay as they are. Every row has a number and a name (say “K2”). Each row: the logo at 64px, then the site’s bar at a desktop width with the logo 32px tall, and a phone with it 24px tall.

K J5 with World of moved to the right

Holger: J5 is the best; move World of to the right a bit. World of’s start moves right in three steps: to the card’s lean (both starts the same distance from the card’s edge, round 13’s rule), and one and two steps past it. Card Games stays where it is, 16 from the edge; only World of moves. The fourth row answers the other question: World of has been GLCA SemiBold since 1a; here it is in GLCA Medium like Card Games, for the comparison.
